issue: `to_roman()` doesn't use subtractive notation: to_roman(4) returns 'IIII' instead of 'IV'. It must produce standard numerals for 1..3999 (e.g. 9 -> 'IX', 40 -> 'XL', 90 -> 'XC', 400 -> 'CD', 900 -> 'CM', 1994 -> 'MCMXCIV') and raise ValueError outside that range.
